notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets that is tapped and attacking.
Salvager of Secrets enters, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
